title: Absolute Continuity of Monotone Aggregations under Positive Regression Dependence
abstract: arXiv:2606.21042v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we provide sufficient conditions for the absolute continuity of one-dimensional push-forwards of dependent random vectors. Suppose that $X$ has an absolutely continuous distribution and that the conditional distribution of an $\mathbb{R}^d$-valued random vector $Y$ given $X=x$ is nondecreasing in $x\in \mathbb{R}$ in the usual stochastic order. For Borel maps $g\colon \mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}$ satisfying a coordinatewise monotonicity condition in $Y$ and a uniform lower-increment condition in $X$, we prove that $g(X,Y)$ has an absolutely continuous distribution. The result requires neither independence nor a joint density, and allows the marginal law of $Y$ to be completely arbitrary. Moreover, the result remains valid if $\mathbb{R}^d$ is replaced by an arbitrary measurable space endowed with a reflexive binary relation. translated_title: 正回归相关性下单调聚合的绝对连续性
translated_abstract: 本文为相依随机向量的一维推前分布的绝对连续性提供了充分条件。假设随机变量X具有绝对连续的分布，且R^d值随机向量Y在给定X=x条件下的分布在通常随机序意义下关于x∈R非递减（即正回归相关性）。对于满足关于Y的逐坐标单调性条件以及关于X的一致下增量条件的Borel映射g: R×R^d→R，我们证明g(X,Y)具有绝对连续的分布。该结果既不要求独立性，也不要求联合密度存在，并且允许Y的边际分布完全任意。此外，若将R^d替换为赋予自反二元关系的任意可测空间，该结果依然成立。我们还讨论了该结果对单调风险聚合的意义及相关扩展。
tldr: 本文证明了在正回归相关性下，满足逐坐标单调性与一致下增量条件的单调聚合函数作用于绝对连续分布的随机变量时，其输出分布必然绝对连续，且无需独立性或联合密度假设。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that under positive regression dependence, monotone aggregations satisfying coordinatewise monotonicity and a uniform lower-increment condition map absolutely continuous random variables to absolutely continuous distributions, requiring neither independence nor joint densities.
